title: LocalLevelBackgroundData
description: Visual scene data. This one schema covers every art file: Levels/level <n> - art.json, Levels/level <n> - cutscenes.json, Levels/title.json, Levels/presentation.json, Levels/ending.json, and the same file names under Level Replacements/<Target Pack>/. Deserialized as Sor2NewEra.Gameplay.LocalLevelBackgroundData. Every image referenced here is a file in Levels/Art/.

scenes.description: Ordered scenes. In a level art file, scene i pairs with scene i of the matching level <n>.json. A null entry reuses the previous scene's background. In a cutscene file, scenes advance on cutsceneEndTimeInSeconds.

animationsDefinition.description: Animation library for this file. Layers reference entries by index through animations[].animationId, so reordering this array silently repoints every reference.

musicPackName.description: Pack the music track is loaded from. Empty means this pack.

musicName.description: Music track played during this scene, as a base file name without extension.

cutsceneEndTimeInSeconds.description: How long a cutscene scene lasts before advancing, in seconds. -1, the default, means the scene does not advance on its own, which is what gameplay scenes use.

layers.description: Visual layers, drawn according to their zOrder.

parallax.description: How fast the layer scrolls relative to the camera. 1 moves with the camera; below 1 is a slower background; above 1 is a faster foreground.

autoScroll.description: Constant self-scrolling speed in pixels per second, independent of the camera.

scrollLoopLimits.description: Wrap distance on each axis. A positive value makes the layer tile endlessly over that span; 0 disables wrapping on that axis.

useClassicLayerMotion.description: Opt into the original Classic layer motion and vertical art offset. Uses updateType for rain, scenery, elevators and the swinging boat. Defaults to false.

staticParallaxType.description: Classic static widescreen registration when useClassicLayerMotion is true: 0 Normal, 1 Skyline, 2 Stage7Elevator.

updateType.description: Special per-frame layer behaviour: 0 Normal, 1 BackyardRain, 2 TruckBrokenDoor, 3 Stage4Elevator, 4 ArenaSpectators, 5 Stage7Elevator, 6 Stage7ElevatorExtra, 7 Stage8Elevator, 8 AntiCameraY, 9 WaveEffect, 10 SmallWaveEffect, 11 SwingingBoat.

reactToQuakeEffect.description: Shake this layer along with the screen during a quake.

positionOffset.description: Shift applied to everything on the layer, in pixels.

zOrder.description: Draw order. Higher values draw in front. Gameplay entities sit at 0, so backgrounds use negative values and foregrounds positive ones.

titleScreenImages.description: Animated entrance images used by title and character select screens.

animations.description: Placed instances of entries in the file's animationsDefinition.

scale.description: Uniform size multiplier around the layer's top-left origin. 0 is treated as 1.

items.description: Genesis 0BGR color word (even channels, mask 0xEEE), or -1 for transparent.
Genesis 0BGR color word (even channels, mask 0xEEE), or -1 for transparent.

preserveInitialPalette.description: Keep base palette until ticksPerFrame, then use normal cycle phase (frame one at the first boundary).

imageName.description: File name inside Levels/Art/, including its extension.

position.description: Position within the layer, in pixels.

scale.description: Size multiplier. 0 is treated as 1, and the absolute value is used. A non-integer scale switches that image to bilinear filtering; integer scales stay pixel sharp.

packName.description: Written by the Level Editor but not read by the runtime: images resolve inside the owning pack's Levels/Art/ folder.

initialXPosition.description: Horizontal offset the image starts from before easing towards position.

lerpSpeed.description: How quickly the image eases towards its target. Higher catches up faster.

initialDelay.description: Seconds to wait before the image starts moving.

wiggleAmplitude.description: How far the image wiggles off its path, in pixels. 0 disables the wiggle.

wiggleFrequency.description: How fast the image wiggles back and forth.

requireCharacterName.description: Only use this entry when the character's name matches, instead of applying it to everyone.

isAICharacter.description: Present this portrait as computer-controlled rather than as a player.

packName.description: Written by the Level Editor but not read by the runtime: images resolve inside the owning pack's Levels/Art/ folder.

animationId.description: Index into the file's animationsDefinition array.

position.description: Placement within the layer, in pixels.

packName.description: Written by the Level Editor but not read by the runtime: every image referenced by an art file is resolved inside the owning pack's Levels/Art/ folder.

imageName.description: File name inside Levels/Art/, including its extension.

delayFrames.description: Game frames this image is held for before the next one.

pivotInPixels.description: Point of the image that sits at the placement position, in pixels from its top-left corner.
